after.en: No term of 1/(n+1) is 0, yet it gets smaller than any positive number you name.

hint.zh: 第一拍的下标是 0。
hint.en: The index is 0 on the first tick.

t.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + …：每加一项，离 1 就近一半。可它到底能不能加到 1？
t.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + …: each term halves the way left to 1. But does it ever reach 1?

after.zh: 差距每步减半，却从来不是 0：部分和逼近 1，没有哪一项等于 1。
after.en: The gap halves every step and is never 0: the partial sums close in on 1 and none equals it.

brief.zh: 交出 1/2 + 1/4 + … 的部分和，和它与 1 的差距。
brief.en: Give the partial sums of 1/2 + 1/4 + … and their gap from 1.

t.zh: 要说「够近」，先得会说「哪个大」。板只会加、乘、取倒数，这些运算都平滑地变，接不出「哪个大」这种一下子跳过去的判断。
t.en: To say “close enough” the machine must first say “which is larger”. The board only adds, multiplies and takes reciprocals, operations that change smoothly; no wiring of them makes a sudden judgement like which is larger.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:less"></part-ref>把这个判断写成数：a < b 时给 1，否则给 0。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:less"></part-ref>, writes that judgement as a number: 1 when a < b, else 0.

after.zh: 真假写成 1 和 0，乘上去就能挑选：比较也成了算术。
after.en: Truth written as 1 and 0 picks by multiplying: comparison has become arithmetic.

desc.zh: 交出 a、b 里大的那个。
desc.en: Gives the larger of a and b.

brief.zh: 每一拍交出两个输入里大的那个。
brief.en: Each tick give the larger of the two inputs.

hint.zh: 比较给出的 1 或 0，乘上 b − a 会怎样？
hint.en: What happens when the 1 or 0 from the comparison multiplies b − a?

t.zh: aₙ 和 L 差多少，用 aₙ − L 量，时正时负：在左边差 3 和在右边差 3，一样远。
t.en: Measuring how far aₙ is from L by aₙ − L gives sometimes a positive, sometimes a negative number: 3 to the left and 3 to the right are equally far.

after.zh: |a − b| 只量隔多远，不看谁在左边。
after.en: |a − b| measures only how far apart, never which is on the left.

desc.zh: 交出 |a − b|。

brief.zh: 每一拍交出两个输入隔多远。
brief.en: Each tick give how far apart the two inputs are.

hint.zh: a − b 和 b − a，总有一个不是负的。
hint.en: Of a − b and b − a, one is never negative.

t.zh: 「很近」没有尺度：离 L 差 0.1 算不算近，看事先怎么说。数学上先给一个正数 ε，离 L 不到 ε 才算近。
t.en: “Very close” has no scale: whether 0.1 from L counts as close depends on what was agreed. Mathematics first names a positive number ε; less than ε from L counts as close.

after.zh: 离 L 不到 ε 的数，叫 L 的 ε 邻域。
after.en: The numbers less than ε from L are L’s ε-neighbourhood.

desc.zh: aₙ 离 L 不到 ε 时为 1，否则为 0。
desc.en: 1 when aₙ is less than ε from L, else 0.

brief.zh: aₙ 离 L 不到 ε 时交出 1，否则交出 0。
brief.en: Give 1 when aₙ is less than ε from L, else 0.

t.zh: 「越来越近」不能只看某一项：前面近了又跑远，就不算。要问的是从哪一项起一直近，不管它之前怎样。
t.en: “Getting closer” cannot rest on one term: close, then far again, does not count. The question is from which term on it stays close, whatever happened before.

t.zh: 先不管近不近，只看一串 0 和 1：最近这段连续的 1 从哪一项开始？
t.en: Leave closeness aside for now and look at a run of 0s and 1s: where did the latest unbroken stretch of 1s begin?

after.zh: 一件事从某一项起一直成立，前面有几项不成立也不要紧。
after.en: Something can hold from some term on, whatever the terms before it did.

desc.zh: 输入最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍为 0 时给 n + 1。
desc.en: Where the latest unbroken run of 1s in its input began; n + 1 when this tick is 0.

brief.zh: 输入每拍是 0 或 1：交出最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍是 0 时交出 n + 1。
brief.en: The input is 0 or 1 each tick: give where the latest unbroken run of 1s began; give n + 1 when this tick is 0.

hint.zh: 这一拍是 1 时，开头和上一拍说的一样。
hint.en: When this tick is 1, the start is what the tick before said.

hint.zh: 输入本身就是 1 或 0，可以拿它在两个数里挑。
hint.en: The input is itself 1 or 0: it can pick between two numbers.

t.zh: <level-ref to="halves"></level-ref>里，部分和加到哪一项都不等于 1。说它趋于 1，凭的是什么？
t.en: In <level-ref to="halves"></level-ref> no partial sum equals 1. On what grounds does the sum tend to 1?

t.zh: 三件元件齐了：<part-ref to="dist"></part-ref>量差多远，<part-ref to="near"></part-ref>按 ε 判近不近，<part-ref to="since"></part-ref>说从哪一项起一直如此。测试给出数列（先是 1/(n+1)）、L 和 ε，把它们接起来，每一拍交出到这一拍为止的 N。
t.en: The three parts are ready: <part-ref to="dist"></part-ref> measures how far, <part-ref to="near"></part-ref> judges closeness by ε, and <part-ref to="since"></part-ref> says from which term it has held. The test gives the sequence (1/(n+1) first), L and ε: wire them up, and each tick give N as found so far.

after.zh: 不管 ε 多小，总有一项 N，从它起每一项都离 L 不到 ε：这就是数列趋于 L。这里只跑了有限拍，N 只在这些拍以内成立。
after.en: However small ε is, there is a term N from which every term is less than ε from L: that is what tending to L means. Only finitely many ticks ran here, so N holds within them only.

brief.zh: aₙ 趋于 L：测试给出 ε，每一拍交出到这一拍为止的 N。
brief.en: aₙ tends to L: the test gives ε; each tick give N as found so far.

hint.zh: ε 越小，N 落在越后面。
hint.en: The smaller ε, the later N falls.

t.zh: (3n + 1)/(n + 2)：0.5, 1.33, 1.75, 2, … 越来越靠近 3。这一回数列由板自己算，邻域以 3 为中心。
t.en: (3n + 1)/(n + 2): 0.5, 1.33, 1.75, 2, … edging towards 3. This time the board computes the sequence itself, and the neighbourhood is centred on 3.

brief.zh: aₙ = (3n + 1)/(n + 2)，L = 3：测试给出 ε，交出 N。
brief.en: aₙ = (3n + 1)/(n + 2), L = 3: the test gives ε; give N.

hint.zh: 分子乘分母的倒数。
hint.en: The numerator times the reciprocal of the denominator.

t.zh: 1, −1/2, 1/3, −1/4, …：一会儿在 0 的右边，一会儿在左边。它也算趋于 0 吗？
t.en: 1, −1/2, 1/3, −1/4, …: now right of 0, now left. Does it tend to 0 as well?

brief.zh: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1)，L = 0：测试给出 ε，交出 N。
brief.en: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1), L = 0: the test gives ε; give N.

t.zh: 1, −1, 1, −1, …：它从不跑远，总在 1 和 −1 之间。它趋于 1？趋于 0？
t.en: 1, −1, 1, −1, …: it never wanders off, always between 1 and −1. Does it tend to 1? To 0?

after.zh: 不管 L 取几，总有某个 ε 让 N 一直被往后推：找不到它趋于的数，这样的数列叫发散。
after.en: Whatever L is, some ε keeps pushing N later: there is no number it tends to, and such a sequence diverges.

brief.zh: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ：测试给出 L 和 ε，交出 N。
brief.en: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ: the test gives L and ε; give N.

t.zh: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2：无穷多项永远加不完，等号右边的 2 是什么意思？能算的只有部分和，问的是部分和趋于什么。
t.en: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2: infinitely many terms never finish adding, so what does the 2 mean? Only partial sums can be computed; the question is what they tend to.

after.zh: 无穷多项相加的值，就是部分和的极限：这样的级数叫收敛。
after.en: The value of infinitely many terms added is the limit of the partial sums: such a series converges.

brief.zh: 交出 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … 的部分和；测试给出 ε，交出它离 2 不到 ε 的 N。
brief.en: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + …; the test gives ε: give the N at which they come within ε of 2.

t.zh: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 + …：每一项都趋于 0，比 1/2ⁿ 慢得多。它的和收敛吗？
t.en: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 + …: every term tends to 0, far more slowly than 1/2ⁿ. Does its sum converge?

after.zh: 项趋于 0，和仍然越过任何界：调和级数发散。项趋于 0 只是级数收敛的必要条件。
after.en: The terms tend to 0 and the sum still passes every bound: the harmonic series diverges. Terms tending to 0 is only a necessary condition for convergence.

brief.en: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …

after.zh: 部分和越长越慢，看起来像要停下。
after.en: The partial sums grow slower and slower, as if about to stop.

brief.zh: 测试给出界 K：交出部分和从第几项起一直大于 K。
brief.en: The test gives a bound K: give where the partial sums start staying above K.

t.zh: n! = 1·2·…·n，0! = 1。1/n! 小得极快：1, 1, 1/2, 1/6, 1/24, …。不必先算出 n! 再取倒数：相邻两项只差一个因子。
t.en: n! = 1·2·…·n, and 0! = 1. 1/n! shrinks extremely fast: 1, 1, 1/2, 1/6, 1/24, …. There is no need to compute n! first: neighbouring terms differ by a single factor.

hint.zh: 1/n! 和 1/(n − 1)! 差一个什么因子？

t.zh: 把阶乘倒数一项项加起来：1 + 1 + 1/2 + 1/6 + …。这个和有自己的名字。测试给出它的值和 ε，看部分和几项就稳定下来。
t.en: Add the reciprocal factorials term by term: 1 + 1 + 1/2 + 1/6 + …. This sum has a name of its own. The test gives its value and ε: watch how few terms the partial sums need to settle.

after.zh: 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … 趋于 e ≈ 2.71828：阶乘长得飞快，几项就准到小数点后好几位。
after.en: 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … tends to e ≈ 2.71828: factorials grow so fast that a few terms are right to several decimal places.

brief.zh: 交出 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … 的部分和；测试给出 e 和 ε，交出部分和离 e 不到 ε 的 N。
brief.en: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + …; the test gives e and ε: give the N at which they come within ε of e.

t.zh: √2 不是两个整数之比，加、乘、取倒数都给不出它本身。可以一步步猜：猜 x 大了，2/x 就小了，√2 夹在两者之间。
t.en: √2 is no ratio of whole numbers, and no adding, multiplying or reciprocal gives it outright. It can be guessed step by step: if a guess x is too large, 2/x is too small, and √2 lies between them.

brief.zh: 从 x₀ = 1 起，交出 xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + 2/xₙ)/2。
brief.en: From x₀ = 1, give xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + 2/xₙ)/2.

hint.zh: 下一次的猜测存回同一张寄存卡。
hint.en: The next guess goes back into the same register.

t.zh: <level-ref to="limit"></level-ref>里，1/(n+1) 要离 0 不到 0.001，得等到第 1000 项。巴比伦的猜测离 √2 有多快？量 xₙ² 离 2 多远。
t.en: In <level-ref to="limit"></level-ref>, 1/(n+1) needs until term 1000 to come within 0.001 of 0. How fast do the Babylonian guesses close in on √2? Measure how far xₙ² is from 2.

after.zh: 误差每步大约平方一次：有效数字一步翻一倍。
after.en: The error roughly squares each step: the correct digits double at every step.

brief.zh: 交出 |xₙ² − 2|；测试给出 ε，交出它小于 ε 的 N。
brief.en: Give |xₙ² − 2|; the test gives ε: give the N at which it drops below ε.

t.zh: 同一台机器换一个数，还能开方吗？把 2 换成测试给出的正数 c。
t.en: Can the same machine take another number’s root? Replace 2 by a positive c from the test.

after.zh: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 从任何正数起都趋于 √c，这就是巴比伦开方。
after.en: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 tends to √c from any positive start: this is the Babylonian square root.

brief.zh: 测试给出正数 c：从 x₀ = 1 起，交出 xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2。
brief.en: The test gives a positive c: from x₀ = 1, give xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2.

question.zh: 只会加和乘，怎样算出数列的任意一项、到这一项为止的和、相邻两项的差？
question.en: With only addition and multiplication, how do you compute any term of a sequence, the sum so far, and the gap between neighbouring terms?

question.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项都不等于 1：「趋于」一个数究竟是什么意思？
question.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + … equals 1 at no term: what exactly does tending to a number mean?

question.zh: 只会加和乘，怎样算出数列的任意一项、到这一项为止的和、相邻两项的差？
question.en: With only addition and multiplication, how do you compute any term of a sequence, the sum so far, and the gap between neighbouring terms?

why: levels step: eras as the blueprint lays them out; divergence and harmonic slots have no naive board

topic.zh: 一元微积分：从一拍算一项的数列机器，搭到导数、积分和微分方程
topic.en: Single-variable calculus: from a machine that computes a term a tick up to derivatives, integrals and differential equations

learner.zh: 会四则运算；不假设学过数列、极限、导数或积分。
learner.en: Knows arithmetic; no sequences, limits, derivatives or integrals assumed.

endpoint.zh: 给自己搭的机器一个函数，它算出导数、积分、泰勒多项式，解出一个常微分方程，并说得清误差随步长怎样变小。
endpoint.en: Hand the machine they built a function, and it computes its derivative, integral and Taylor polynomial and solves an ordinary differential equation, with the error’s fall as the step shrinks explained.

scope.zh: 这份蓝图写第 0 章「一拍一项」和第 1 章「越来越近」：数列、递推、求和与差分，到极限、级数收敛与发散，带两个专题。第 2–7 章各记一句，留待后续。
scope.en: This blueprint covers chapter 0, “A term a tick”, and chapter 1, “Getting closer”: sequences, recurrences, sums and differences, up to limits and convergent and divergent series, with two topics. Chapters 2–7 get one line each, for later.

where.zh: 整个游戏：第 n 拍算第 n 项，寄存卡跨拍保存
where.en: The whole game: tick n computes term n, registers keep values across ticks

why.zh: 数列的递推就是逐拍的状态：首项是寄存卡的初值，递推式是接到存寄存卡上的电路；累加和差分都由玩家亲手接出，而不是一件现成的元件。没有共用线：世界只把输入数列一拍一项交给板。
why.en: A recurrence is state from tick to tick: the first term is a register’s start value and the rule is the wiring into its keep; sum and difference are wired by the player rather than given. There is no shared line: the world only hands the input sequences to the board, a term a tick.

about.zh: 每拍跑一遍板，读各输入这一拍的项，交出各输出这一拍的项
about.en: Run the board once a tick, reading each input’s term and giving each output’s term

lacks.zh: 它算得出任意多项，却说不出一个数列「趋于」什么：1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项为止都不是 1。没有倒数，也比较不了两个数的大小。第 1 章加上倒数和比较，问「越来越近」是什么意思。
lacks.en: It computes as many terms as asked, but cannot say what a sequence tends to: 1/2 + 1/4 + … never equals 1 at any term. It has no reciprocal and cannot compare two numbers. Chapter 1 adds both and asks what “getting closer” means.

lacks.zh: 它沿着下标一项项走，只认得数列；函数 f(x) 要在任意实数 x 上取值，相邻两点要能任意近。第 2 章把函数放到步长 h 的网格上取样，让步长本身趋于 0。
lacks.en: It walks term by term along an index and knows only sequences; a function f(x) takes values at any real x, with points as close as wanted. Chapter 2 samples functions on a grid of step h and lets the step itself tend to 0.

about.zh: 按下标排好的一串数 a₀, a₁, a₂, …；两个数列逐项相加，得到的仍是数列，第 n 项是两者第 n 项的和。
about.en: Numbers in order of their index, a₀, a₁, a₂, …; adding two sequences term by term gives a sequence whose n-th term is the sum of their n-th terms.

wall.zh: 三个数列每拍各来一项，合起来的数列第 n 项是多少？
wall.en: Three sequences each bring a term a tick: what is the n-th term of their sum?

misconception.zh: 把数列当成一个数，而不是一项一项的整体。
misconception.en: Taking a sequence for one number rather than a whole made of terms.

about.zh: aₙ₋₁ 也是一个数列：原数列整体晚一项，开头补一个初值。
about.en: aₙ₋₁ is a sequence too: the original one a term late, with a start value in front.

wall.zh: 板每一拍从头算，算完什么也不留：怎样交出上一项？
wall.en: The board starts afresh each tick and keeps nothing: how can it give the term before?

misconception.zh: 以为机器自然记得上一步算过什么。
misconception.en: Thinking the machine naturally remembers what it computed the step before.

about.zh: 一个数列由首项和「怎样从上一项算出这一项」完全决定，例如首项 3、aₙ = aₙ₋₁ + 2。
about.en: A sequence is fixed entirely by its first term and how each term comes from the one before, e.g. first term 3, aₙ = aₙ₋₁ + 2.

wall.zh: 没有输入，要一项项交出 3, 5, 7, 9, …：无穷多项从哪里来？
wall.en: With no input, give 3, 5, 7, 9, … term by term: where do infinitely many terms come from?

misconception.zh: 要给出无穷多项，就得把它们一项项写下来。
misconception.en: Giving infinitely many terms means writing them down one by one.

about.zh: 第几项本身也是一个数列 0, 1, 2, …：首项 0、每项加 1 的递推；通项公式以它为自变量。
about.en: Which term it is forms a sequence too, 0, 1, 2, …: the recurrence starting at 0 and adding 1; a general term takes it as its variable.

wall.zh: 板不知道现在是第几拍：怎样让它知道 n？
wall.en: The board does not know which tick it is: how can it know n?

about.zh: 第 n 项直接由 n 算出，aₙ = f(n)，不经过前面的项。
about.en: The n-th term computed straight from n, aₙ = f(n), without the terms before it.

wall.zh: 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …：相邻两项差的不是同一个数，递推写不成「加一个常数」，第 n 项却很好算。
wall.en: 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …: the gaps keep changing, so no “add a constant” recurrence fits, yet the n-th term is easy to say.

misconception.zh: 数列只能一项项递推出来。
misconception.en: A sequence can only be made by stepping from term to term.

about.zh: 每一项是上一项乘同一个数（公比）：aₙ = r·aₙ₋₁，长得比任何等差数列都快。
about.en: Each term is the one before times the same number, the ratio: aₙ = r·aₙ₋₁; it outgrows every arithmetic sequence.

wall.zh: 3, 6, 12, 24, …：每一项加多少？加的数一直在变。
wall.en: 3, 6, 12, 24, …: how much is added each time? The amount keeps changing.

misconception.zh: 翻倍就是每次加上首项。
misconception.en: Doubling means adding the first term each time.

about.zh: Sₙ = a₀ + a₁ + … + aₙ；部分和本身是数列，由递推 Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ 算出。级数就是部分和的数列。
about.en: Sₙ = a₀ + a₁ + … + aₙ; the partial sums form a sequence, made by the recurrence Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ. A series is the sequence of its partial sums.

wall.zh: 前面所有项的和：项一拍只来一个，和却要用到全部。
wall.en: The sum of every term so far: terms come one a tick, but the sum needs them all.

misconception.zh: 每拍把这一项和上一项加起来就是总和。
misconception.en: Adding this term to the one before gives the total.

about.zh: Δaₙ = aₙ − aₙ₋₁（约定 a₋₁ = 0）：数列每一步变了多少。二次的数列差分后是一次的，再差一次是常数。
about.en: Δaₙ = aₙ − aₙ₋₁ (taking a₋₁ = 0): how much a sequence changes at each step. A quadratic differences to a linear one, and again to a constant.

wall.zh: 相邻两项差多少？板上没有减法。
wall.en: How far apart are neighbouring terms? There is no subtraction on the board.

misconception.zh: 差分要用 aₙ₋₁ − aₙ，或者没有减法元件就做不到。
misconception.en: The difference is aₙ₋₁ − aₙ, or it cannot be done without a subtraction part.

about.zh: 先累加再差分，先差分再累加，都回到原来的数列（a₋₁ = 0 时）：离散的微积分基本定理。
about.en: Summing then differencing, or differencing then summing, gives back the sequence (with a₋₁ = 0): the fundamental theorem of calculus, in its discrete form.

wall.zh: 只知道一个数列每一步变了多少（或前几项的和），怎样还原它本身？
wall.en: Knowing only how much a sequence changes each step (or its running total), how do you recover the sequence itself?

misconception.zh: 要撤销差分，就再差分一次。
misconception.en: Undoing a difference means taking another difference.

about.zh: 越来越接近 0 的数列，如 1/(n+1)：每一项都不是 0，却能小过任何给定的正数。
about.en: A sequence closing in on 0, like 1/(n+1): no term is 0, yet it gets smaller than any positive number given.

wall.en: 1, 1/2, 1/3, …: with no division, how do you compute 1/(n+1)?

misconception.zh: 越来越小的数最后会等于 0。
misconception.en: Numbers that keep shrinking end up at 0.

about.zh: a < b 的真假写成 1 和 0，就是一个数列；乘上去，就能在两个数里挑一个：max(a, b) = a + [a < b]·(b − a)。
about.en: Writing whether a < b as 1 or 0 gives a sequence; multiplied in, it picks one of two numbers: max(a, b) = a + [a < b]·(b − a).

knowledge.source: Stewart, Calculus: Early Transcendentals 8e Appendix A

wall.zh: 板只会加和乘，算不出两个数里哪个大。
wall.en: The board only adds and multiplies; it cannot tell which of two numbers is larger.

about.zh: |a − b| 是数轴上两点隔多远，不看谁在左边：它是 a − b 和 b − a 里较大的那个。
about.en: |a − b| is how far apart two points of the number line are, whichever is on the left: the larger of a − b and b − a.

knowledge.source: Stewart, Calculus: Early Transcendentals 8e Appendix A

wall.zh: a − b 时正时负；要的只是隔多远。
wall.en: a − b is sometimes positive and sometimes negative; what is wanted is only how far apart.

misconception.zh: 距离就是 a − b。
misconception.en: The distance is a − b.

about.zh: 离 L 不到 ε 的所有数：|x − L| < ε。ε 是事先说好的「多近才算近」。
about.en: Every number less than ε from L: |x − L| < ε. ε is the agreed answer to how close counts as close.

wall.zh: 「很近」没有尺度：先说好近到多少才算。
wall.en: “Very close” has no scale: first agree how close counts.

about.zh: 一件事从某一项起一直成立，前面有几项不成立也不要紧。这一拍以内，那一项就是最近一段连续成立的开头。
about.en: Something holding from some term on, whatever happens before it. Within the ticks so far, that term is where the latest unbroken run of it began.

wall.zh: 一串 0 和 1：最近这段 1 从哪一项开始？一出现 0 就得重算。
wall.en: A run of 0s and 1s: where did the latest stretch of 1s begin? A 0 starts the count again.

about.zh: 数列 aₙ 趋于 L：不管 ε 多小，总有一项 N，从它起每一项都在 L 的 ε 邻域里。记作 lim aₙ = L。
about.en: aₙ tends to L: however small ε is, there is a term N from which every term lies in the ε-neighbourhood of L. Written lim aₙ = L.

wall.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项都不是 1，凭什么说它趋于 1？
wall.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + … is never 1 at any term: on what grounds does it tend to 1?

misconception.zh: 趋于 L 就是越来越近，或者最后等于 L。
misconception.en: Tending to L means getting ever closer, or finally equalling L.

about.zh: 找不到任何 L 让数列趋于它：不管 L 取几，总有某个 ε，N 一直被往后推。
about.en: No L the sequence tends to: whatever L is, some ε keeps pushing N later and later.

wall.zh: (−1)ⁿ 总在 1 和 −1 之间跳：它趋于什么？
wall.en: (−1)ⁿ keeps jumping between 1 and −1: what does it tend to?

misconception.zh: 不跑到无穷大的数列都收敛。
misconception.en: Every sequence that does not run off to infinity converges.

about.zh: 无穷多项相加的值，就是部分和数列的极限：1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2，因为 Sₙ 趋于 2。
about.en: The value of adding infinitely many terms is the limit of the partial sums: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2 because Sₙ tends to 2.

wall.zh: 加无穷多项，永远加不完：等号右边的 2 从哪里来？
wall.en: Adding infinitely many terms never finishes: where does the 2 on the right come from?

about.zh: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …：每一项都趋于 0，部分和却超过任何界，发散。项趋于 0 只是级数收敛的必要条件。
about.en: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …: its terms tend to 0, yet the partial sums pass every bound; it diverges. Terms tending to 0 is only necessary for a series to converge.

wall.zh: 每一项都越来越小，和还会无限变大吗？
wall.en: Every term keeps shrinking: can the sum still grow without bound?

misconception.zh: 项趋于 0，级数就收敛。
misconception.en: If the terms tend to 0, the series converges.

about.en: e = 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + 1/3! + … ≈ 2.71828: factorials grow so fast that this series settles in a few terms.

wall.zh: 一个由无穷多项定义的数，怎样一位位算出来？
wall.en: A number defined by infinitely many terms: how is it computed digit by digit?

about.zh: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 从任意正数起趋于 √c：猜得大了，c/xₙ 就小了，取两者的平均。收敛极快，每一步有效数字约翻一倍。
about.en: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 tends to √c from any positive start: when a guess is too large, c/xₙ is too small, and the average takes both. It converges very fast, roughly doubling the correct digits each step.

wall.zh: 只会加、乘和取倒数，怎样算出 √2？
wall.en: With only add, multiply and reciprocal, how do you compute √2?

about.zh: 加：两个数相加。
about.en: Add: two numbers added.

why.zh: 板上一开始只有输入和输出；任何运算都要从一种接不出来的运算起步，加法是最小的那一种。
why.en: The board starts with inputs and outputs only; every computation starts from an operation that cannot be wired, and addition is the smallest.

about.zh: 读寄存卡：同名寄存卡里存的值，存入之前给初值。
about.en: Register: what the register of the same name holds, its start value before.

why.zh: 板每拍从头算；跨拍的值只能由寄存卡这一对元件保存，任何接法都接不出来。
why.en: The board starts afresh each tick; a value across ticks can be held only by the register pair, and no wiring makes it.

about.zh: 存寄存卡：接入的值存进同名寄存卡，下一拍读得出。
about.en: Keep: its input stored in the register of the same name, read from the next tick.

why.zh: 和读寄存卡是一对：一个存、一个读。
why.en: The other half of the register pair: one stores, one reads.

about.zh: 常数：给出设定的数。
about.en: Constant: the number it is set to.

why.zh: 输入只给变化的项；一个固定的公差、一个 −1，只能由常数给出。
why.en: Inputs give only changing terms; a fixed difference or a −1 can come only from a constant.

about.zh: 乘：两个数相乘。
about.en: Multiply: two numbers multiplied.

why.zh: 加法重复 n 次要 n 块元件，而 n 每拍在变；乘法接不出来。
why.en: Repeating an addition n times takes n parts, and n changes every tick; multiplication cannot be wired.

about.zh: 倒数：1/x，x 为 0 时给「—」。
about.en: Reciprocal: 1/x, 「—」 when x is 0.

why.zh: 加和乘从整数出发只得到整数；1/(n+1) 这样越来越小的数接不出来。
why.en: Adding and multiplying whole numbers gives whole numbers; something like 1/(n+1), shrinking ever smaller, cannot be wired.

about.zh: 比较：a < b 时给 1，否则给 0。
about.en: Less: 1 when a < b, else 0.

why.zh: 加、乘、倒数都是光滑的运算，接不出「哪个大」这种跳变。
why.en: Add, multiply and reciprocal are smooth operations; no wiring of them makes a jump like which one is larger.

about.en: Index: gives 0, 1, 2, …

about.zh: 累加 Σ：交出输入到这一拍为止的部分和。
about.en: Sum Σ: the partial sum of its input up to this tick.

about.zh: 差分 Δ：交出输入这一项减上一项（第一拍减 0）。
about.en: Difference Δ: its input’s term minus the one before (minus 0 on the first tick).

about.zh: 较大者：a、b 里大的那个。
about.en: Max: the larger of a and b.

about.zh: 距离：|a − b|。
about.en: Distance: |a − b|.

about.zh: 邻域：|a − L| < ε 时为 1，否则为 0。
about.en: Near: 1 when |a − L| < ε, else 0.

about.zh: 从此一直：输入最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍为 0 时给 n + 1。
about.en: Since: where the latest unbroken run of 1s in its input began; n + 1 when this tick is 0.

question.zh: 只会加和乘，怎样算出数列的任意一项、到这一项为止的和、相邻两项的差？
question.en: With only addition and multiplication, how do you compute any term of a sequence, the sum so far, and the gap between neighbouring terms?

why.zh: 从一台每拍从头算一遍、什么也不记得的板起步：先逐项运算，再用寄存卡记住上一项，于是有了递推、下标和通项，最后搭出求和与差分两件元件，看它们互相撤销。
why.en: It starts from a board that computes afresh every tick and remembers nothing: term-by-term arithmetic first, then a register to remember the term before, which brings recurrences, the index and the general term; finally the sum and the difference, built as parts, undo each other.

task.zh: 三个输入数列逐项相加，交出合起来的数列。
task.en: Add three input sequences term by term and give the sequence they make.

question.zh: 两个数列相加，结果的第 n 项是什么？
question.en: When two sequences are added, what is the n-th term of the result?

chain.zh: 运行一次，看到三个输入每拍各来一项，输出每拍要一项。
chain.en: Run once: each input brings one term a tick, and the output wants one a tick.

chain.zh: 一块加只收两个数：先加两列，再把第三列加上去。
chain.en: One add takes two numbers: add two sequences, then add the third.

chain.zh: 每一拍的结果只看这一拍的三项：数列的加法是逐项的。
chain.en: Each tick’s result needs only that tick’s three terms: adding sequences goes term by term.

task.zh: 每一拍交出输入上一拍的项；第一拍交出 0。
task.en: Each tick give the input’s term from the tick before; give 0 on the first tick.

question.zh: 怎样让机器交出 aₙ₋₁？
question.en: How can the machine give aₙ₋₁?

chain.zh: 把输入直接接到输出，每一拍都早了一项。
chain.en: Wire the input straight to the output: every tick is a term early.

chain.zh: 存寄存卡把这一拍的项存起来，读寄存卡下一拍才读得出。
chain.en: Keep stores this tick’s term; Register reads it only the next tick.

chain.zh: 第一拍还什么也没存：初值就是 a₋₁。
chain.en: On the first tick nothing is stored yet: the start value is a₋₁.

naive.zh: 把输入直接接到输出：看起来就是那个数列，却早了一项。
naive.en: Wiring the input straight to the output: it looks like the sequence, but a term early.

task.zh: 没有输入：交出首项 3、之后每项比上一项多 2 的数列。
task.en: No input: give the sequence starting at 3, each term 2 more than the one before.

question.zh: 没有输入，无穷多项从哪里来？
question.en: With no input, where do infinitely many terms come from?

chain.zh: 板上只有寄存卡和加：要一个固定的 2，需要常数。
chain.en: The board has a register and an add: a fixed 2 needs a constant.

chain.zh: 读寄存卡给出上一项，加上 2 存回去，就是下一项。
chain.en: The register gives the term before; add 2 and keep it, and that is the next term.

chain.zh: 首项写在寄存卡的初值上：首项加递推式，整个数列就定了。
chain.en: The first term is the register’s start value: a first term plus a rule fixes the whole sequence.

naive.zh: 输出常数 3 再每拍加 2：板不记得，每拍都是 5。
naive.en: A constant 3 plus 2 each tick: the board remembers nothing, so it is 5 every tick.

task.zh: 交出 0, 1, 2, 3, …：这一拍是第几项。
task.en: Give 0, 1, 2, 3, …: which term this tick is.

question.zh: 板不知道现在是第几拍，怎样让它知道 n？
question.en: The board does not know which tick it is: how can it know n?

chain.zh: 第几项每拍多 1，从 0 开始。
chain.en: The term number grows by 1 each tick, starting from 0.

chain.zh: 这正是首项 0、每项加 1 的递推，和上一关同一种接法。
chain.en: That is the recurrence starting at 0 and adding 1, wired like the steady steps.

chain.zh: 搭好以后它成了一件元件：以后的关直接拿 n 来算。
chain.en: Built, it becomes a part: later levels compute straight from n.

task.en: Give 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …: the n-th term is n².

question.zh: 相邻两项的差一直在变，第 n 项还能直接算出来吗？
question.en: The gaps between terms keep changing: can the n-th term still be computed directly?

chain.zh: 试着写成等差的递推：1、3、5、7，加的数每拍不同。
chain.en: Try a steady-step recurrence: it adds 1, 3, 5, 7, a different amount each tick.

chain.zh: 换个想法：第 n 项只和 n 有关，n 乘 n 就是它。
chain.en: Think again: the n-th term depends only on n, and n times n is it.

chain.zh: 下标接两次到乘上，不经过前面任何一项。
chain.en: The index goes into a multiply twice, through none of the terms before.

naive.zh: 首项 0、每项加 2 的递推：0, 2, 4, 6，第二项就错了。
naive.en: Start at 0 and add 2 each time: 0, 2, 4, 6, wrong from the third term.

task.zh: 交出首项 3、之后每项是上一项两倍的数列。
task.en: Give the sequence starting at 3, each term twice the one before.

question.zh: 每一项是上一项的两倍时，递推式长什么样？
question.en: When each term is twice the one before, what does the rule look like?

chain.zh: 3, 6, 12, 24：前两步各加 3、6，加的数在变。
chain.en: 3, 6, 12, 24: the steps add 3, then 6; the amount changes.

chain.zh: 不变的是比：每一项都是上一项乘 2。
chain.en: What stays the same is the ratio: each term is the one before times 2.

chain.zh: 寄存卡给出上一项，乘 2 存回去。
chain.en: The register gives the term before; times 2, kept back.

naive.zh: 每次加首项 3：3, 6, 9, 12，第三项起就落后了。
naive.en: Adding the first term 3 each time: 3, 6, 9, 12, behind from the third term.

task.zh: 每一拍交出输入到这一拍为止所有项的和。
task.en: Each tick give the sum of every input term so far.

question.zh: 项一拍只来一个，怎样一直知道全部的和？
question.en: Terms arrive one a tick: how can the machine always know the total?

chain.zh: 把这一项和上一项加起来，第三拍就漏了第一项。
chain.en: Add this term and the one before: by the third tick the first term is lost.

chain.zh: 存起来的不该是上一项，而是到上一拍为止的和。
chain.en: What to keep is not the term before but the sum up to the tick before.

chain.zh: Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ：部分和也是一个递推，首项 0。
chain.en: Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ: the partial sums are a recurrence too, starting from 0.

naive.zh: 这一项加上一项：只记得最近两项。
naive.en: This term plus the one before: it remembers only the last two.

task.en: Give 0 + 1 + … + n.

question.zh: 要求和的数列不是输入给的，而是板自己算的，怎么办？
question.en: What if the sequence to sum is not given but made on the board?

chain.zh: 没有输入：要加的是 0, 1, 2, …
chain.en: No input: what is added is 0, 1, 2, …

chain.zh: 下标就是这个数列，把它接进累加。
chain.en: The index is that sequence; feed it into the sum.

facet.zh: 被求和的数列由板自己算出，不再由测试给出。
facet.en: The sequence summed is made on the board, no longer given by the test.

task.zh: 交出三角形数的部分和：0, 1, 4, 10, 20, …
task.en: Give the partial sums of the triangular numbers: 0, 1, 4, 10, 20, …

question.zh: 部分和的部分和是什么样子？
question.en: What do the partial sums of partial sums look like?

chain.zh: 三角形数本身是部分和，再求一次和。
chain.en: The triangular numbers are partial sums already; sum them again.

chain.zh: 两件累加串起来：每件都只管自己的和。
chain.en: Two sums in a row: each keeps its own total.

facet.zh: 求和叠两层：每一层的部分和都是下一层要加的数列。
facet.en: Summing two levels deep: each level’s partial sums are the sequence the next one adds.

question.zh: 等比数列的部分和长成什么样？
question.en: What do the partial sums of a geometric sequence grow like?

chain.zh: 先搭出 1, 2, 4, 8, …，再接进累加。
chain.en: Build 1, 2, 4, 8, … and feed it into the sum.

chain.zh: 看结果：1, 3, 7, 15，每个都比下一项少 1。
chain.en: Look at the result: 1, 3, 7, 15, each one less than the next term.

facet.zh: 等比数列的部分和仍按同一个公比增长：每个部分和都比下一项少 1。
facet.en: The partial sums of a geometric sequence grow by its ratio too: each is one less than the next term.

task.zh: 每一拍交出输入这一项减上一项；第一拍减 0。
task.en: Each tick give the input’s term minus the one before; minus 0 on the first tick.

question.zh: 没有减法，怎样算出相邻两项差多少？
question.en: Without subtraction, how do you get how far apart neighbouring terms are?

chain.zh: 上一项由寄存卡给出，和上一项那一关一样。
chain.en: The term before comes from a register, as for the term before.

chain.zh: 减去一个数，就是加上它乘 −1。
chain.en: Subtracting a number is adding it times −1.

chain.zh: 顺序是这一项减上一项：数列变大时差分为正。
chain.en: The order is this term minus the one before: a growing sequence has positive differences.

naive.zh: 上一项减这一项：大小对，符号反了。
naive.en: The term before minus this one: the size is right, the sign is wrong.

task.zh: 交出 n² 的差分。
task.en: Give the differences of n².

question.zh: 平方数每一步变了多少？
question.en: How much do the squares change at each step?

chain.zh: 先算出 n²，再接进差分。
chain.en: Compute n², then feed it into the difference.
The result 0, 1, 3, 5, 7: the odd numbers, 2 more each time.

facet.zh: 被差分的数列由板自己算出；二次的数列差分后是一次的。
facet.en: The sequence differenced is made on the board; a quadratic differences to a linear one.

task.zh: 交出 n² 的差分的差分。
task.en: Give the differences of the differences of n².

question.zh: 差分再做一次，平方数会变成什么？
question.en: Differencing again, what do the squares become?

chain.zh: 两件差分串起来。
chain.en: Two differences in a row.

chain.zh: 开头几项之后一直是 2：二次的数列差两次变成常数。
chain.en: After the first terms it is 2 throughout: a quadratic differenced twice is a constant.

facet.zh: 差分叠两层：二次的数列差两次只剩常数，这就是差分机只用加法造表的原理。
facet.en: Differencing two levels deep: a quadratic twice differenced leaves a constant, the principle that lets the difference engine make tables with additions alone.

task.en: Give the differences of 1, 2, 4, 8, …

question.zh: 等比数列每一步变了多少？
question.en: How much does a geometric sequence change at each step?

chain.zh: 先搭出 1, 2, 4, 8, …，再接进差分。
chain.en: Build 1, 2, 4, 8, …, then feed it into the difference.

chain.zh: 结果 1, 1, 2, 4, 8：除了开头，差分就是数列自己晚一项。
chain.en: The result 1, 1, 2, 4, 8: apart from the start, the differences are the sequence itself, a term late.

facet.zh: 翻倍数列的差分还是翻倍数列：它是自己的差分（以后的 eˣ 是自己的导数）。
facet.en: A doubling sequence differences to a doubling sequence: it is its own difference (as eˣ will be its own derivative).

task.zh: 由一个数列的差分还原它；由部分和还原各项；由二阶差分还原数列。
task.en: Recover a sequence from its differences; recover the terms from their partial sums; recover a sequence from its second differences.

question.zh: 只知道一个数列每一步变了多少，怎样还原它本身？
question.en: Knowing only how much a sequence changes each step, how do you recover it?

chain.zh: 输入是差分：每一步变了多少。把变化一步步加起来，就回到数列。
chain.en: The input is the differences: how much each step changes. Adding the changes up step by step gives back the sequence.

chain.zh: 输入换成部分和：相邻两个和的差就是那一项。
chain.en: Now the input is partial sums: the difference of neighbouring sums is that term.

chain.zh: 二阶差分要加回两次：每次累加撤销一次差分。
chain.en: Second differences need summing back twice: each sum undoes one difference.

naive.zh: 对差分再做一次差分，以为那就是撤销。
naive.en: Differencing the differences again, thinking that undoes them.

task.zh: 不用差分元件、也不用乘，交出 1, 2, 4, 8, … 的差分。
task.en: Without the difference part or multiplication, give the differences of 1, 2, 4, 8, …

question.zh: 减不了，也乘不了 −1，差分还算得出来吗？
question.en: With no way to subtract or multiply by −1, can the differences still be computed?

chain.zh: 先看要交出的数列本身：1, 1, 2, 4, 8, …
chain.en: Look at the sequence wanted itself: 1, 1, 2, 4, 8, …

chain.zh: 从第二项起，它是翻倍数列晚了一项；第一项是 1 − 0。
chain.en: From its second term on it is the doubling sequence a term late; its first term is 1 − 0.

chain.zh: 翻倍也不必乘：一个数加上它自己。
chain.en: Doubling needs no multiplication either: a number plus itself.

naive.zh: 把翻倍数列晚一项交出，初值照旧写 0：第一项就错了。
naive.en: Giving the doubling sequence a term late with the usual start value 0: the first term is wrong.

question.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项都不等于 1：「趋于」一个数究竟是什么意思？
question.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + … equals 1 at no term: what exactly does tending to a number mean?

why.zh: 数列机算得出任意多项，却判断不了「越来越近」。这一章加上倒数和比较，把 ε-N 定义拆成几件元件——距离、邻域、从此一直——拼起来检查极限，再用它分清收敛和发散的级数。
why.en: The sequence machine computes as many terms as asked but cannot judge “getting closer”. This chapter adds reciprocal and comparison and takes the ε-N definition apart into parts — distance, neighbourhood, ever since — that wire together to check a limit, and then to tell convergent series from divergent ones.

question.zh: 没有除法，怎样算出 1/(n+1)？
question.en: With no division, how do you compute 1/(n+1)?

chain.zh: 除以一个数，就是乘它的倒数；这里只要倒数本身。
chain.en: Dividing by a number is multiplying by its reciprocal; here the reciprocal alone is wanted.

chain.zh: 1/n 在第一拍是 1/0：从 n+1 取倒数。
chain.en: 1/n is 1/0 on the first tick: take the reciprocal of n+1.

naive.zh: 直接取下标的倒数：第一拍是 1/0，没有值。
naive.en: The reciprocal of the index itself: 1/0 on the first tick, no value.

task.zh: 交出 1/2 + 1/4 + … 的部分和，和它与 1 的差距。
task.en: Give the partial sums of 1/2 + 1/4 + … and their gap from 1.

question.zh: 部分和离 1 还差多少？这个差距会变成 0 吗？
question.en: How far are the partial sums from 1? Does the gap ever reach 0?

chain.zh: 1/2, 1/4, … 是公比 1/2 的等比数列，累加起来。
chain.en: 1/2, 1/4, … is geometric with ratio 1/2; sum it.

chain.zh: 1 减去部分和：乘 −1 再加 1。差距每步减半，永远不是 0。
chain.en: 1 minus the partial sum: times −1, plus 1. The gap halves each step and is never 0.

facet.zh: 部分和与 1 的差距本身是无穷小：部分和逼近 1，却没有哪一项等于 1。
facet.en: The gap between the partial sums and 1 is itself infinitesimal: the sums close in on 1 though none equals it.

task.zh: 每一拍交出两个输入里大的那个。
task.en: Each tick give the larger of the two inputs.

question.zh: 板只会算，怎样在两个数里挑出大的？
question.en: The board only computes: how can it pick the larger of two numbers?

chain.zh: 比较给出 1 或 0：b 更大时是 1。
chain.en: Comparing gives 1 or 0: 1 when b is larger.

chain.zh: a 加上 (b − a) 乘这个 1 或 0：是 1 就变成 b，是 0 就还是 a。
chain.en: a plus (b − a) times that 1 or 0: with 1 it becomes b, with 0 it stays a.

task.zh: 每一拍交出两个输入隔多远：|a − b|。
task.en: Each tick give how far apart the two inputs are: |a − b|.

question.zh: a − b 时正时负，怎样只要隔多远？
question.en: a − b is sometimes negative: how do you get just how far apart?

chain.zh: a − b 和 b − a 一正一负（或都是 0）。
chain.en: a − b and b − a are one positive and one negative (or both 0).

chain.zh: 取两者里大的那个。
chain.en: Take the larger of the two.

naive.zh: 只算 a − b：b 更大时成了负数。
naive.en: Just a − b: negative when b is larger.

task.zh: aₙ 离 L 不到 ε 时交出 1，否则交出 0。
task.en: Give 1 when aₙ is less than ε from L, else 0.

question.zh: 怎样把「够近」变成一个能检查的 0 或 1？
question.en: How does “close enough” become a 0 or 1 that can be checked?

chain.zh: 先量 aₙ 和 L 隔多远。
chain.en: First measure how far aₙ is from L.

chain.zh: 再和 ε 比较：小于 ε 就是够近。
chain.en: Then compare with ε: less than ε is close enough.

task.zh: 输入每拍是 0 或 1：交出最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍是 0 时交出 n + 1。
task.en: The input is 0 or 1 each tick: give where the latest unbroken run of 1s began; give n + 1 when this tick is 0.

question.zh: 一串 0 和 1，最近这段 1 从哪一项开始？
question.en: In a run of 0s and 1s, where did the latest stretch of 1s begin?

chain.zh: 这一拍是 1：开头和上一拍说的一样，由寄存卡记着。
chain.en: This tick is 1: the start is what the tick before said, held in a register.

chain.zh: 这一拍是 0：开头最早也得是下一项，n + 1。
chain.en: This tick is 0: the start can be no earlier than the next term, n + 1.

chain.zh: 用输入当 1 和 0 在两者里挑：f·旧值 + (1 − f)·(n + 1)。
chain.en: Use the input as 1 and 0 to pick between them: f·old + (1 − f)·(n + 1).

task.zh: aₙ 趋于 L：测试给出 ε，每一拍交出到这一拍为止的 N。
task.en: aₙ tends to L: the test gives ε; each tick give N as found so far.

question.zh: 加到哪一项都不等于 L，凭什么说它趋于 L？
question.en: No term equals L: on what grounds does the sequence tend to L?

chain.zh: 先说好多近才算近：ε。
chain.en: First agree how close counts: ε.

chain.zh: 每一拍检查 aₙ 在不在邻域里，看这段「在」从哪一项起。
chain.en: Each tick check whether aₙ is in the neighbourhood, and where the current stretch of “in” began.

chain.zh: N 停住了，就是这一拍以内找到了 N；ε 越小，N 越往后。
chain.en: When N stops moving, an N has been found within these ticks; the smaller ε, the later N.

naive.zh: 只看这一拍在不在邻域里：前面掉出去过也不管。
naive.en: Looking only at whether this tick is in the neighbourhood, ignoring any earlier escape.

question.zh: 极限不是 0 时，ε-N 照样适用吗？
question.en: Does ε-N work the same when the limit is not 0?

chain.zh: 数列要自己算：分子乘分母的倒数。
chain.en: Compute the sequence yourself: the numerator times the reciprocal of the denominator.

chain.zh: 邻域以 3 为中心，其余照旧。
chain.en: The neighbourhood is centred on 3; the rest is as before.

facet.zh: 被检查的数列由板自己算出，极限不是 0。
facet.en: The sequence checked is made on the board, and its limit is not 0.

task.en: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1), L = 0: give N.

question.zh: 一会儿在左、一会儿在右，还算趋于 0 吗？
question.en: Now left, now right: does it still tend to 0?

chain.zh: (−1)ⁿ 是首项 1、公比 −1 的等比数列。
chain.en: (−1)ⁿ is geometric with first term 1 and ratio −1.

chain.zh: 距离不看方向：两边的项一样算近。
chain.en: Distance ignores direction: terms on either side are close alike.

facet.zh: 数列在 L 两侧来回摆动；邻域只看距离，摆动不妨碍收敛。
facet.en: The sequence swings from side to side of L; the neighbourhood only sees distance, so swinging does not stop convergence.

task.zh: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ：测试给出 L 和 ε，交出 N。
task.en: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ: the test gives L and ε; give N.

question.zh: 一个数列能不能哪儿也不趋于？
question.en: Can a sequence tend nowhere at all?

chain.zh: L 取 1：每隔一项就掉出邻域，N 一直被往后推。
chain.en: With L = 1: every other term falls out, and N keeps being pushed back.

chain.zh: L 取别的数也一样：没有哪个 L 让 N 停下。
chain.en: Any other L does the same: no L lets N stop.

task.zh: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … 趋于 2：测试给出 ε，交出 N。
task.en: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … tends to 2: the test gives ε; give N.

question.zh: 无穷多项相加，等号右边的 2 是什么意思？
question.en: Infinitely many terms added: what does the 2 on the right mean?

chain.zh: 无穷多项加不完；能算的只有部分和。
chain.en: Infinitely many terms never finish adding; only partial sums can be computed.

chain.zh: 问部分和这个数列趋于什么：对它找 N。
chain.en: Ask what the sequence of partial sums tends to: find N for it.

task.zh: 交出 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + … 的部分和；再对测试给出的界 K，交出部分和从第几项起一直大于 K。
task.en: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …; then, for a bound K the test gives, give where the partial sums start staying above K.

question.zh: 每一项都趋于 0，和还会无限变大吗？
question.en: Every term tends to 0: can the sum still grow without bound?

chain.zh: 部分和长得很慢，看起来像停了。
chain.en: The partial sums grow so slowly they look stuck.

chain.zh: 给它一个界 K，比较「K 小于部分和」，从此一直：K 再大也找得到那一项。
chain.en: Give it a bound K, compare “K less than the sum”, and take ever since: however large K, that term is found.

question.zh: 1/n! 不必先算出 n! 再取倒数吗？
question.en: Must 1/n! wait for n! to be computed first?

chain.zh: n! = n·(n − 1)!：相邻两项只差一个因子。
chain.en: n! = n·(n − 1)!: neighbouring terms differ by one factor.

chain.zh: 于是 1/n! = 1/(n − 1)! · 1/n：递推，每步乘一个倒数。
chain.en: So 1/n! = 1/(n − 1)! · 1/n: a recurrence, multiplying by one reciprocal each step.

task.zh: 交出 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … 的部分和，和它离 e 不到 ε 的 N。
task.en: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … and the N at which they come within ε of e.

question.zh: 一个由无穷多项定义的数，几项才算得准？
question.en: A number defined by infinitely many terms: how many terms make it accurate?

chain.zh: 把阶乘倒数接进累加。
chain.en: Feed the reciprocal factorials into the sum.

chain.zh: 对 e 找 N：阶乘长得飞快，N 很小。
chain.en: Find N for e: factorials grow so fast that N is small.

task.zh: 从 x₀ = 1 起，交出 xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + 2/xₙ)/2。
task.en: From x₀ = 1, give xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + 2/xₙ)/2.

question.zh: 只会加、乘和取倒数，怎样逼近 √2？
question.en: With only add, multiply and reciprocal, how do you close in on √2?

chain.zh: 猜 x 大了，2/x 就小了；√2 夹在两者之间。
chain.en: If a guess x is too large, 2/x is too small; √2 lies between them.

chain.zh: 取两者的平均当下一次的猜测，存回寄存卡。
chain.en: Take their average as the next guess and keep it.

task.zh: 交出 |xₙ² − 2| 和它小于 ε 的 N。
task.en: Give |xₙ² − 2| and the N at which it drops below ε.

question.zh: 巴比伦的猜测逼近得有多快？
question.en: How fast do the Babylonian guesses close in?

chain.zh: 误差用距离量：xₙ² 离 2 多远。
chain.en: Measure the error with distance: how far xₙ² is from 2.

chain.zh: 和 1/(n+1) 比：ε 缩小十倍，N 几乎不动。
chain.en: Compare with 1/(n+1): ε ten times smaller hardly moves N.

task.zh: 测试给出正数 c：从 1 起，交出逼近 √c 的猜测。
task.en: The test gives a positive c: from 1, give guesses closing in on √c.

question.zh: 换成别的数，同一台机器还能开方吗？
question.en: With another number, does the same machine still take the root?

chain.zh: 把 2 换成输入 c：c 乘 xₙ 的倒数。
chain.en: Replace 2 by the input c: c times the reciprocal of xₙ.

chain.zh: c 小于 1 时，第一次猜测大了，照样收回来。
chain.en: When c is below 1 the first guess is too large, and it still comes back.

why.zh: 求和与差分都只建在寄存卡、递推和下标上，彼此不需要；先做哪一路都行，汇合在互逆。
why.en: Summing and differencing each stand only on the register, recurrences and the index, not on each other; either may come first, and they meet at undoing.

why.zh: 倒数、比较和「从此一直」各建在第 0 章的元件上，彼此不需要；在极限汇合。
why.en: Reciprocal, comparison and “ever since” each stand on chapter 0’s parts, not on each other; they meet at the limit.

about.zh: 值是数，不是位；板上没有线和「说」：只有输入数列和输出。原始元件：加、乘、常数、寄存卡一对。测试写出每个输入每拍的项和每个输出每拍应当的项（物化成数据，不由公式生成）。
about.en: Values are numbers, not bits; boards have no line and no say card, only input sequences and outputs. Primitives: add, multiply, constant, the register pair. A test lists each input’s terms and each output’s wanted terms, tick by tick (materialised data, not generated by formula).

note.zh: kit/domains/calculus：输入、输出数列两种固定卡，加、乘、常数、寄存卡一对；测试写明每拍的项；常数和初值是任意数（registerCards 的 numbers）。
note.en: kit/domains/calculus: input and output sequence cards, add, multiply, constant and the register pair; tests list every term; constants and start values take any number (registerCards numbers).

about.zh: 一种画逐拍数值的显示方式：每一项一个点，横轴是下标、纵轴是值（数列图），和应当的项叠在一起，能一眼看出增长的快慢。
about.en: A view of tick-by-tick numbers: a dot per term, the index across and the value up (a sequence plot), drawn over the wanted terms so growth is seen at a glance.

note.zh: 逐拍的数值多了两种显示方式：逐项（每拍一列写出数）和数列图（每项一个点，应当的项画成圈，同一刻度）；游戏的 views 选用它们。
note.en: Values a tick gain two views: terms (each tick’s number in its column) and plot (a dot a term, the wanted terms as rings on one scale); the game’s views pick them.

about.zh: 原始元件加上倒数（1/0 给「—」）和比较（a < b 给 1，否则 0）；测试的项按相对误差 10⁻⁹ 对照，运算顺序造成的末位差别不算错。
about.en: Primitives gain reciprocal (「—」 for 1/0) and less (1 when a < b, else 0); a test’s terms are compared within a relative error of 10⁻⁹, so differences in the last bits from the order of operations are no error.

note.zh: kit/domains/calculus：原始元件 recip、less；run.js 的 same 按相对误差 10⁻⁹ 对照。
note.en: kit/domains/calculus: primitives recip and less; run.js same compares within a relative error of 10⁻⁹.

about.zh: 第 2–7 章：取样、导数、积分、基本定理、泰勒、微分方程
about.en: Chapters 2–7: sampling, derivative, integral, the fundamental theorem, Taylor, differential equations

why.zh: 同上；框架在设计文档第 3 节
why.en: As above; the framework is in the design document, §3

question.zh: 只会加和乘，怎样算出数列的任意一项、到这一项为止的和、相邻两项的差？
question.en: With only addition and multiplication, how do you compute any term of a sequence, the sum so far, and the gap between neighbouring terms?

question.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项都不等于 1：「趋于」一个数究竟是什么意思？
question.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + … equals 1 at no term: what exactly does tending to a number mean?

question.zh: 只会加和乘，怎样算出数列的任意一项、到这一项为止的和、相邻两项的差？
question.en: With only addition and multiplication, how do you compute any term of a sequence, the sum so far, and the gap between neighbouring terms?

question.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项都不等于 1：「趋于」一个数究竟是什么意思？
question.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + … equals 1 at no term: what exactly does tending to a number mean?

topic.zh: 一元微积分：从一拍算一项的数列机器，搭到导数、积分和微分方程
topic.en: Single-variable calculus: from a machine that computes a term a tick up to derivatives, integrals and differential equations

learner.zh: 会四则运算；不假设学过数列、极限、导数或积分。
learner.en: Knows arithmetic; no sequences, limits, derivatives or integrals assumed.

endpoint.zh: 给自己搭的机器一个函数，它算出导数、积分、泰勒多项式，解出一个常微分方程，并说得清误差随步长怎样变小。
endpoint.en: Hand the machine they built a function, and it computes its derivative, integral and Taylor polynomial and solves an ordinary differential equation, with the error’s fall as the step shrinks explained.

scope.zh: 这份蓝图写第 0 章「一拍一项」和第 1 章「越来越近」：数列、递推、求和与差分，到极限、级数收敛与发散，带两个专题。第 2–7 章各记一句，留待后续。
scope.en: This blueprint covers chapter 0, “A term a tick”, and chapter 1, “Getting closer”: sequences, recurrences, sums and differences, up to limits and convergent and divergent series, with two topics. Chapters 2–7 get one line each, for later.

where.zh: 整个游戏：第 n 拍算第 n 项，寄存卡跨拍保存
where.en: The whole game: tick n computes term n, registers keep values across ticks

why.zh: 数列的递推就是逐拍的状态：首项是寄存卡的初值，递推式是接到存寄存卡上的电路；累加和差分都由玩家亲手接出，而不是一件现成的元件。没有共用线：世界只把输入数列一拍一项交给板。
why.en: A recurrence is state from tick to tick: the first term is a register’s start value and the rule is the wiring into its keep; sum and difference are wired by the player rather than given. There is no shared line: the world only hands the input sequences to the board, a term a tick.

about.zh: 每拍跑一遍板，读各输入这一拍的项，交出各输出这一拍的项
about.en: Run the board once a tick, reading each input’s term and giving each output’s term

lacks.zh: 它算得出任意多项，却说不出一个数列「趋于」什么：1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项为止都不是 1。没有倒数，也比较不了两个数的大小。第 1 章加上倒数和比较，问「越来越近」是什么意思。
lacks.en: It computes as many terms as asked, but cannot say what a sequence tends to: 1/2 + 1/4 + … never equals 1 at any term. It has no reciprocal and cannot compare two numbers. Chapter 1 adds both and asks what “getting closer” means.

lacks.zh: 它沿着下标一项项走，只认得数列；函数 f(x) 要在任意实数 x 上取值，相邻两点要能任意近。第 2 章把函数放到步长 h 的网格上取样，让步长本身趋于 0。
lacks.en: It walks term by term along an index and knows only sequences; a function f(x) takes values at any real x, with points as close as wanted. Chapter 2 samples functions on a grid of step h and lets the step itself tend to 0.

about.zh: 按下标排好的一串数 a₀, a₁, a₂, …；两个数列逐项相加，得到的仍是数列，第 n 项是两者第 n 项的和。
about.en: Numbers in order of their index, a₀, a₁, a₂, …; adding two sequences term by term gives a sequence whose n-th term is the sum of their n-th terms.

wall.zh: 三个数列每拍各来一项，合起来的数列第 n 项是多少？
wall.en: Three sequences each bring a term a tick: what is the n-th term of their sum?

misconception.zh: 把数列当成一个数，而不是一项一项的整体。
misconception.en: Taking a sequence for one number rather than a whole made of terms.

about.zh: aₙ₋₁ 也是一个数列：原数列整体晚一项，开头补一个初值。
about.en: aₙ₋₁ is a sequence too: the original one a term late, with a start value in front.

wall.zh: 板每一拍从头算，算完什么也不留：怎样交出上一项？
wall.en: The board starts afresh each tick and keeps nothing: how can it give the term before?

misconception.zh: 以为机器自然记得上一步算过什么。
misconception.en: Thinking the machine naturally remembers what it computed the step before.

about.zh: 一个数列由首项和「怎样从上一项算出这一项」完全决定，例如首项 3、aₙ = aₙ₋₁ + 2。
about.en: A sequence is fixed entirely by its first term and how each term comes from the one before, e.g. first term 3, aₙ = aₙ₋₁ + 2.

wall.zh: 没有输入，要一项项交出 3, 5, 7, 9, …：无穷多项从哪里来？
wall.en: With no input, give 3, 5, 7, 9, … term by term: where do infinitely many terms come from?

misconception.zh: 要给出无穷多项，就得把它们一项项写下来。
misconception.en: Giving infinitely many terms means writing them down one by one.

about.zh: 第几项本身也是一个数列 0, 1, 2, …：首项 0、每项加 1 的递推；通项公式以它为自变量。
about.en: Which term it is forms a sequence too, 0, 1, 2, …: the recurrence starting at 0 and adding 1; a general term takes it as its variable.

wall.zh: 板不知道现在是第几拍：怎样让它知道 n？
wall.en: The board does not know which tick it is: how can it know n?

about.zh: 第 n 项直接由 n 算出，aₙ = f(n)，不经过前面的项。
about.en: The n-th term computed straight from n, aₙ = f(n), without the terms before it.

wall.zh: 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …：相邻两项差的不是同一个数，递推写不成「加一个常数」，第 n 项却很好算。
wall.en: 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …: the gaps keep changing, so no “add a constant” recurrence fits, yet the n-th term is easy to say.

misconception.zh: 数列只能一项项递推出来。
misconception.en: A sequence can only be made by stepping from term to term.

about.zh: 每一项是上一项乘同一个数（公比）：aₙ = r·aₙ₋₁，长得比任何等差数列都快。
about.en: Each term is the one before times the same number, the ratio: aₙ = r·aₙ₋₁; it outgrows every arithmetic sequence.

wall.zh: 3, 6, 12, 24, …：每一项加多少？加的数一直在变。
wall.en: 3, 6, 12, 24, …: how much is added each time? The amount keeps changing.

misconception.zh: 翻倍就是每次加上首项。
misconception.en: Doubling means adding the first term each time.

about.zh: Sₙ = a₀ + a₁ + … + aₙ；部分和本身是数列，由递推 Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ 算出。级数就是部分和的数列。
about.en: Sₙ = a₀ + a₁ + … + aₙ; the partial sums form a sequence, made by the recurrence Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ. A series is the sequence of its partial sums.

wall.zh: 前面所有项的和：项一拍只来一个，和却要用到全部。
wall.en: The sum of every term so far: terms come one a tick, but the sum needs them all.

misconception.zh: 每拍把这一项和上一项加起来就是总和。
misconception.en: Adding this term to the one before gives the total.

about.zh: Δaₙ = aₙ − aₙ₋₁（约定 a₋₁ = 0）：数列每一步变了多少。二次的数列差分后是一次的，再差一次是常数。
about.en: Δaₙ = aₙ − aₙ₋₁ (taking a₋₁ = 0): how much a sequence changes at each step. A quadratic differences to a linear one, and again to a constant.

wall.zh: 相邻两项差多少？板上没有减法。
wall.en: How far apart are neighbouring terms? There is no subtraction on the board.

misconception.zh: 差分要用 aₙ₋₁ − aₙ，或者没有减法元件就做不到。
misconception.en: The difference is aₙ₋₁ − aₙ, or it cannot be done without a subtraction part.

about.zh: 先累加再差分，先差分再累加，都回到原来的数列（a₋₁ = 0 时）：离散的微积分基本定理。
about.en: Summing then differencing, or differencing then summing, gives back the sequence (with a₋₁ = 0): the fundamental theorem of calculus, in its discrete form.

wall.zh: 只知道一个数列每一步变了多少（或前几项的和），怎样还原它本身？
wall.en: Knowing only how much a sequence changes each step (or its running total), how do you recover the sequence itself?

misconception.zh: 要撤销差分，就再差分一次。
misconception.en: Undoing a difference means taking another difference.

about.zh: 越来越接近 0 的数列，如 1/(n+1)：每一项都不是 0，却能小过任何给定的正数。
about.en: A sequence closing in on 0, like 1/(n+1): no term is 0, yet it gets smaller than any positive number given.

wall.en: 1, 1/2, 1/3, …: with no division, how do you compute 1/(n+1)?

misconception.zh: 越来越小的数最后会等于 0。
misconception.en: Numbers that keep shrinking end up at 0.

about.zh: a < b 的真假写成 1 和 0，就是一个数列；乘上去，就能在两个数里挑一个：max(a, b) = a + [a < b]·(b − a)。
about.en: Writing whether a < b as 1 or 0 gives a sequence; multiplied in, it picks one of two numbers: max(a, b) = a + [a < b]·(b − a).

knowledge.source: Stewart, Calculus: Early Transcendentals 8e Appendix A

wall.zh: 板只会加和乘，算不出两个数里哪个大。
wall.en: The board only adds and multiplies; it cannot tell which of two numbers is larger.

about.zh: |a − b| 是数轴上两点隔多远，不看谁在左边：它是 a − b 和 b − a 里较大的那个。
about.en: |a − b| is how far apart two points of the number line are, whichever is on the left: the larger of a − b and b − a.

knowledge.source: Stewart, Calculus: Early Transcendentals 8e Appendix A

wall.zh: a − b 时正时负；要的只是隔多远。
wall.en: a − b is sometimes positive and sometimes negative; what is wanted is only how far apart.

misconception.zh: 距离就是 a − b。
misconception.en: The distance is a − b.

about.zh: 离 L 不到 ε 的所有数：|x − L| < ε。ε 是事先说好的「多近才算近」。
about.en: Every number less than ε from L: |x − L| < ε. ε is the agreed answer to how close counts as close.

wall.zh: 「很近」没有尺度：先说好近到多少才算。
wall.en: “Very close” has no scale: first agree how close counts.

about.zh: 一件事从某一项起一直成立，前面有几项不成立也不要紧。这一拍以内，那一项就是最近一段连续成立的开头。
about.en: Something holding from some term on, whatever happens before it. Within the ticks so far, that term is where the latest unbroken run of it began.

wall.zh: 一串 0 和 1：最近这段 1 从哪一项开始？一出现 0 就得重算。
wall.en: A run of 0s and 1s: where did the latest stretch of 1s begin? A 0 starts the count again.

about.zh: 数列 aₙ 趋于 L：不管 ε 多小，总有一项 N，从它起每一项都在 L 的 ε 邻域里。记作 lim aₙ = L。
about.en: aₙ tends to L: however small ε is, there is a term N from which every term lies in the ε-neighbourhood of L. Written lim aₙ = L.

wall.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项都不是 1，凭什么说它趋于 1？
wall.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + … is never 1 at any term: on what grounds does it tend to 1?

misconception.zh: 趋于 L 就是越来越近，或者最后等于 L。
misconception.en: Tending to L means getting ever closer, or finally equalling L.

about.zh: 找不到任何 L 让数列趋于它：不管 L 取几，总有某个 ε，N 一直被往后推。
about.en: No L the sequence tends to: whatever L is, some ε keeps pushing N later and later.

wall.zh: (−1)ⁿ 总在 1 和 −1 之间跳：它趋于什么？
wall.en: (−1)ⁿ keeps jumping between 1 and −1: what does it tend to?

misconception.zh: 不跑到无穷大的数列都收敛。
misconception.en: Every sequence that does not run off to infinity converges.

about.zh: 无穷多项相加的值，就是部分和数列的极限：1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2，因为 Sₙ 趋于 2。
about.en: The value of adding infinitely many terms is the limit of the partial sums: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2 because Sₙ tends to 2.

wall.zh: 加无穷多项，永远加不完：等号右边的 2 从哪里来？
wall.en: Adding infinitely many terms never finishes: where does the 2 on the right come from?

about.zh: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …：每一项都趋于 0，部分和却超过任何界，发散。项趋于 0 只是级数收敛的必要条件。
about.en: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …: its terms tend to 0, yet the partial sums pass every bound; it diverges. Terms tending to 0 is only necessary for a series to converge.

wall.zh: 每一项都越来越小，和还会无限变大吗？
wall.en: Every term keeps shrinking: can the sum still grow without bound?

misconception.zh: 项趋于 0，级数就收敛。
misconception.en: If the terms tend to 0, the series converges.

about.en: e = 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + 1/3! + … ≈ 2.71828: factorials grow so fast that this series settles in a few terms.

wall.zh: 一个由无穷多项定义的数，怎样一位位算出来？
wall.en: A number defined by infinitely many terms: how is it computed digit by digit?

about.zh: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 从任意正数起趋于 √c：猜得大了，c/xₙ 就小了，取两者的平均。收敛极快，每一步有效数字约翻一倍。
about.en: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 tends to √c from any positive start: when a guess is too large, c/xₙ is too small, and the average takes both. It converges very fast, roughly doubling the correct digits each step.

wall.zh: 只会加、乘和取倒数，怎样算出 √2？
wall.en: With only add, multiply and reciprocal, how do you compute √2?

about.zh: 加：两个数相加。
about.en: Add: two numbers added.

why.zh: 板上一开始只有输入和输出；任何运算都要从一种接不出来的运算起步，加法是最小的那一种。
why.en: The board starts with inputs and outputs only; every computation starts from an operation that cannot be wired, and addition is the smallest.

about.zh: 读寄存卡：同名寄存卡里存的值，存入之前给初值。
about.en: Register: what the register of the same name holds, its start value before.

why.zh: 板每拍从头算；跨拍的值只能由寄存卡这一对元件保存，任何接法都接不出来。
why.en: The board starts afresh each tick; a value across ticks can be held only by the register pair, and no wiring makes it.

about.zh: 存寄存卡：接入的值存进同名寄存卡，下一拍读得出。
about.en: Keep: its input stored in the register of the same name, read from the next tick.

why.zh: 和读寄存卡是一对：一个存、一个读。
why.en: The other half of the register pair: one stores, one reads.

about.zh: 常数：给出设定的数。
about.en: Constant: the number it is set to.

why.zh: 输入只给变化的项；一个固定的公差、一个 −1，只能由常数给出。
why.en: Inputs give only changing terms; a fixed difference or a −1 can come only from a constant.

about.zh: 乘：两个数相乘。
about.en: Multiply: two numbers multiplied.

why.zh: 加法重复 n 次要 n 块元件，而 n 每拍在变；乘法接不出来。
why.en: Repeating an addition n times takes n parts, and n changes every tick; multiplication cannot be wired.

about.zh: 倒数：1/x，x 为 0 时给「—」。
about.en: Reciprocal: 1/x, 「—」 when x is 0.

why.zh: 加和乘从整数出发只得到整数；1/(n+1) 这样越来越小的数接不出来。
why.en: Adding and multiplying whole numbers gives whole numbers; something like 1/(n+1), shrinking ever smaller, cannot be wired.

about.zh: 比较：a < b 时给 1，否则给 0。
about.en: Less: 1 when a < b, else 0.

why.zh: 加、乘、倒数都是光滑的运算，接不出「哪个大」这种跳变。
why.en: Add, multiply and reciprocal are smooth operations; no wiring of them makes a jump like which one is larger.

about.en: Index: gives 0, 1, 2, …

about.zh: 累加 Σ：交出输入到这一拍为止的部分和。
about.en: Sum Σ: the partial sum of its input up to this tick.

about.zh: 差分 Δ：交出输入这一项减上一项（第一拍减 0）。
about.en: Difference Δ: its input’s term minus the one before (minus 0 on the first tick).

about.zh: 较大者：a、b 里大的那个。
about.en: Max: the larger of a and b.

about.zh: 距离：|a − b|。
about.en: Distance: |a − b|.

about.zh: 邻域：|a − L| < ε 时为 1，否则为 0。
about.en: Near: 1 when |a − L| < ε, else 0.

about.zh: 从此一直：输入最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍为 0 时给 n + 1。
about.en: Since: where the latest unbroken run of 1s in its input began; n + 1 when this tick is 0.

question.zh: 只会加和乘，怎样算出数列的任意一项、到这一项为止的和、相邻两项的差？
question.en: With only addition and multiplication, how do you compute any term of a sequence, the sum so far, and the gap between neighbouring terms?

why.zh: 从一台每拍从头算一遍、什么也不记得的板起步：先逐项运算，再用寄存卡记住上一项，于是有了递推、下标和通项，最后搭出求和与差分两件元件，看它们互相撤销。
why.en: It starts from a board that computes afresh every tick and remembers nothing: term-by-term arithmetic first, then a register to remember the term before, which brings recurrences, the index and the general term; finally the sum and the difference, built as parts, undo each other.

task.zh: 三个输入数列逐项相加，交出合起来的数列。
task.en: Add three input sequences term by term and give the sequence they make.

question.zh: 两个数列相加，结果的第 n 项是什么？
question.en: When two sequences are added, what is the n-th term of the result?

chain.zh: 运行一次，看到三个输入每拍各来一项，输出每拍要一项。
chain.en: Run once: each input brings one term a tick, and the output wants one a tick.

chain.zh: 一块加只收两个数：先加两列，再把第三列加上去。
chain.en: One add takes two numbers: add two sequences, then add the third.

chain.zh: 每一拍的结果只看这一拍的三项：数列的加法是逐项的。
chain.en: Each tick’s result needs only that tick’s three terms: adding sequences goes term by term.

task.zh: 每一拍交出输入上一拍的项；第一拍交出 0。
task.en: Each tick give the input’s term from the tick before; give 0 on the first tick.

question.zh: 怎样让机器交出 aₙ₋₁？
question.en: How can the machine give aₙ₋₁?

chain.zh: 把输入直接接到输出，每一拍都早了一项。
chain.en: Wire the input straight to the output: every tick is a term early.

chain.zh: 存寄存卡把这一拍的项存起来，读寄存卡下一拍才读得出。
chain.en: Keep stores this tick’s term; Register reads it only the next tick.

chain.zh: 第一拍还什么也没存：初值就是 a₋₁。
chain.en: On the first tick nothing is stored yet: the start value is a₋₁.

naive.zh: 把输入直接接到输出：看起来就是那个数列，却早了一项。
naive.en: Wiring the input straight to the output: it looks like the sequence, but a term early.

task.zh: 没有输入：交出首项 3、之后每项比上一项多 2 的数列。
task.en: No input: give the sequence starting at 3, each term 2 more than the one before.

question.zh: 没有输入，无穷多项从哪里来？
question.en: With no input, where do infinitely many terms come from?

chain.zh: 板上只有寄存卡和加：要一个固定的 2，需要常数。
chain.en: The board has a register and an add: a fixed 2 needs a constant.

chain.zh: 读寄存卡给出上一项，加上 2 存回去，就是下一项。
chain.en: The register gives the term before; add 2 and keep it, and that is the next term.

chain.zh: 首项写在寄存卡的初值上：首项加递推式，整个数列就定了。
chain.en: The first term is the register’s start value: a first term plus a rule fixes the whole sequence.

naive.zh: 输出常数 3 再每拍加 2：板不记得，每拍都是 5。
naive.en: A constant 3 plus 2 each tick: the board remembers nothing, so it is 5 every tick.

task.zh: 交出 0, 1, 2, 3, …：这一拍是第几项。
task.en: Give 0, 1, 2, 3, …: which term this tick is.

question.zh: 板不知道现在是第几拍，怎样让它知道 n？
question.en: The board does not know which tick it is: how can it know n?

chain.zh: 第几项每拍多 1，从 0 开始。
chain.en: The term number grows by 1 each tick, starting from 0.

chain.zh: 这正是首项 0、每项加 1 的递推，和上一关同一种接法。
chain.en: That is the recurrence starting at 0 and adding 1, wired like the steady steps.

chain.zh: 搭好以后它成了一件元件：以后的关直接拿 n 来算。
chain.en: Built, it becomes a part: later levels compute straight from n.

task.en: Give 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, …: the n-th term is n².

question.zh: 相邻两项的差一直在变，第 n 项还能直接算出来吗？
question.en: The gaps between terms keep changing: can the n-th term still be computed directly?

chain.zh: 试着写成等差的递推：1、3、5、7，加的数每拍不同。
chain.en: Try a steady-step recurrence: it adds 1, 3, 5, 7, a different amount each tick.

chain.zh: 换个想法：第 n 项只和 n 有关，n 乘 n 就是它。
chain.en: Think again: the n-th term depends only on n, and n times n is it.

chain.zh: 下标接两次到乘上，不经过前面任何一项。
chain.en: The index goes into a multiply twice, through none of the terms before.

naive.zh: 首项 0、每项加 2 的递推：0, 2, 4, 6，第二项就错了。
naive.en: Start at 0 and add 2 each time: 0, 2, 4, 6, wrong from the third term.

task.zh: 交出首项 3、之后每项是上一项两倍的数列。
task.en: Give the sequence starting at 3, each term twice the one before.

question.zh: 每一项是上一项的两倍时，递推式长什么样？
question.en: When each term is twice the one before, what does the rule look like?

chain.zh: 3, 6, 12, 24：前两步各加 3、6，加的数在变。
chain.en: 3, 6, 12, 24: the steps add 3, then 6; the amount changes.

chain.zh: 不变的是比：每一项都是上一项乘 2。
chain.en: What stays the same is the ratio: each term is the one before times 2.

chain.zh: 寄存卡给出上一项，乘 2 存回去。
chain.en: The register gives the term before; times 2, kept back.

naive.zh: 每次加首项 3：3, 6, 9, 12，第三项起就落后了。
naive.en: Adding the first term 3 each time: 3, 6, 9, 12, behind from the third term.

task.zh: 每一拍交出输入到这一拍为止所有项的和。
task.en: Each tick give the sum of every input term so far.

question.zh: 项一拍只来一个，怎样一直知道全部的和？
question.en: Terms arrive one a tick: how can the machine always know the total?

chain.zh: 把这一项和上一项加起来，第三拍就漏了第一项。
chain.en: Add this term and the one before: by the third tick the first term is lost.

chain.zh: 存起来的不该是上一项，而是到上一拍为止的和。
chain.en: What to keep is not the term before but the sum up to the tick before.

chain.zh: Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ：部分和也是一个递推，首项 0。
chain.en: Sₙ = Sₙ₋₁ + aₙ: the partial sums are a recurrence too, starting from 0.

naive.zh: 这一项加上一项：只记得最近两项。
naive.en: This term plus the one before: it remembers only the last two.

task.en: Give 0 + 1 + … + n.

question.zh: 要求和的数列不是输入给的，而是板自己算的，怎么办？
question.en: What if the sequence to sum is not given but made on the board?

chain.zh: 没有输入：要加的是 0, 1, 2, …
chain.en: No input: what is added is 0, 1, 2, …

chain.zh: 下标就是这个数列，把它接进累加。
chain.en: The index is that sequence; feed it into the sum.

facet.zh: 被求和的数列由板自己算出，不再由测试给出。
facet.en: The sequence summed is made on the board, no longer given by the test.

task.zh: 交出三角形数的部分和：0, 1, 4, 10, 20, …
task.en: Give the partial sums of the triangular numbers: 0, 1, 4, 10, 20, …

question.zh: 部分和的部分和是什么样子？
question.en: What do the partial sums of partial sums look like?

chain.zh: 三角形数本身是部分和，再求一次和。
chain.en: The triangular numbers are partial sums already; sum them again.

chain.zh: 两件累加串起来：每件都只管自己的和。
chain.en: Two sums in a row: each keeps its own total.

facet.zh: 求和叠两层：每一层的部分和都是下一层要加的数列。
facet.en: Summing two levels deep: each level’s partial sums are the sequence the next one adds.

question.zh: 等比数列的部分和长成什么样？
question.en: What do the partial sums of a geometric sequence grow like?

chain.zh: 先搭出 1, 2, 4, 8, …，再接进累加。
chain.en: Build 1, 2, 4, 8, … and feed it into the sum.

chain.zh: 看结果：1, 3, 7, 15，每个都比下一项少 1。
chain.en: Look at the result: 1, 3, 7, 15, each one less than the next term.

facet.zh: 等比数列的部分和仍按同一个公比增长：每个部分和都比下一项少 1。
facet.en: The partial sums of a geometric sequence grow by its ratio too: each is one less than the next term.

task.zh: 每一拍交出输入这一项减上一项；第一拍减 0。
task.en: Each tick give the input’s term minus the one before; minus 0 on the first tick.

question.zh: 没有减法，怎样算出相邻两项差多少？
question.en: Without subtraction, how do you get how far apart neighbouring terms are?

chain.zh: 上一项由寄存卡给出，和上一项那一关一样。
chain.en: The term before comes from a register, as for the term before.

chain.zh: 减去一个数，就是加上它乘 −1。
chain.en: Subtracting a number is adding it times −1.

chain.zh: 顺序是这一项减上一项：数列变大时差分为正。
chain.en: The order is this term minus the one before: a growing sequence has positive differences.

naive.zh: 上一项减这一项：大小对，符号反了。
naive.en: The term before minus this one: the size is right, the sign is wrong.

task.zh: 交出 n² 的差分。
task.en: Give the differences of n².

question.zh: 平方数每一步变了多少？
question.en: How much do the squares change at each step?

chain.zh: 先算出 n²，再接进差分。
chain.en: Compute n², then feed it into the difference.
The result 0, 1, 3, 5, 7: the odd numbers, 2 more each time.

facet.zh: 被差分的数列由板自己算出；二次的数列差分后是一次的。
facet.en: The sequence differenced is made on the board; a quadratic differences to a linear one.

task.zh: 交出 n² 的差分的差分。
task.en: Give the differences of the differences of n².

question.zh: 差分再做一次，平方数会变成什么？
question.en: Differencing again, what do the squares become?

chain.zh: 两件差分串起来。
chain.en: Two differences in a row.

chain.zh: 开头几项之后一直是 2：二次的数列差两次变成常数。
chain.en: After the first terms it is 2 throughout: a quadratic differenced twice is a constant.

facet.zh: 差分叠两层：二次的数列差两次只剩常数，这就是差分机只用加法造表的原理。
facet.en: Differencing two levels deep: a quadratic twice differenced leaves a constant, the principle that lets the difference engine make tables with additions alone.

task.en: Give the differences of 1, 2, 4, 8, …

question.zh: 等比数列每一步变了多少？
question.en: How much does a geometric sequence change at each step?

chain.zh: 先搭出 1, 2, 4, 8, …，再接进差分。
chain.en: Build 1, 2, 4, 8, …, then feed it into the difference.

chain.zh: 结果 1, 1, 2, 4, 8：除了开头，差分就是数列自己晚一项。
chain.en: The result 1, 1, 2, 4, 8: apart from the start, the differences are the sequence itself, a term late.

facet.zh: 翻倍数列的差分还是翻倍数列：它是自己的差分（以后的 eˣ 是自己的导数）。
facet.en: A doubling sequence differences to a doubling sequence: it is its own difference (as eˣ will be its own derivative).

task.zh: 由一个数列的差分还原它；由部分和还原各项；由二阶差分还原数列。
task.en: Recover a sequence from its differences; recover the terms from their partial sums; recover a sequence from its second differences.

question.zh: 只知道一个数列每一步变了多少，怎样还原它本身？
question.en: Knowing only how much a sequence changes each step, how do you recover it?

chain.zh: 输入是差分：每一步变了多少。把变化一步步加起来，就回到数列。
chain.en: The input is the differences: how much each step changes. Adding the changes up step by step gives back the sequence.

chain.zh: 输入换成部分和：相邻两个和的差就是那一项。
chain.en: Now the input is partial sums: the difference of neighbouring sums is that term.

chain.zh: 二阶差分要加回两次：每次累加撤销一次差分。
chain.en: Second differences need summing back twice: each sum undoes one difference.

naive.zh: 对差分再做一次差分，以为那就是撤销。
naive.en: Differencing the differences again, thinking that undoes them.

task.zh: 不用差分元件、也不用乘，交出 1, 2, 4, 8, … 的差分。
task.en: Without the difference part or multiplication, give the differences of 1, 2, 4, 8, …

question.zh: 减不了，也乘不了 −1，差分还算得出来吗？
question.en: With no way to subtract or multiply by −1, can the differences still be computed?

chain.zh: 先看要交出的数列本身：1, 1, 2, 4, 8, …
chain.en: Look at the sequence wanted itself: 1, 1, 2, 4, 8, …

chain.zh: 从第二项起，它是翻倍数列晚了一项；第一项是 1 − 0。
chain.en: From its second term on it is the doubling sequence a term late; its first term is 1 − 0.

chain.zh: 翻倍也不必乘：一个数加上它自己。
chain.en: Doubling needs no multiplication either: a number plus itself.

naive.zh: 把翻倍数列晚一项交出，初值照旧写 0：第一项就错了。
naive.en: Giving the doubling sequence a term late with the usual start value 0: the first term is wrong.

question.zh: 1/2 + 1/4 + … 加到哪一项都不等于 1：「趋于」一个数究竟是什么意思？
question.en: 1/2 + 1/4 + … equals 1 at no term: what exactly does tending to a number mean?

why.zh: 数列机算得出任意多项，却判断不了「越来越近」。这一章加上倒数和比较，把 ε-N 定义拆成几件元件——距离、邻域、从此一直——拼起来检查极限，再用它分清收敛和发散的级数。
why.en: The sequence machine computes as many terms as asked but cannot judge “getting closer”. This chapter adds reciprocal and comparison and takes the ε-N definition apart into parts — distance, neighbourhood, ever since — that wire together to check a limit, and then to tell convergent series from divergent ones.

question.zh: 没有除法，怎样算出 1/(n+1)？
question.en: With no division, how do you compute 1/(n+1)?

chain.zh: 除以一个数，就是乘它的倒数；这里只要倒数本身。
chain.en: Dividing by a number is multiplying by its reciprocal; here the reciprocal alone is wanted.

chain.zh: 1/n 在第一拍是 1/0：从 n+1 取倒数。
chain.en: 1/n is 1/0 on the first tick: take the reciprocal of n+1.

naive.zh: 直接取下标的倒数：第一拍是 1/0，没有值。
naive.en: The reciprocal of the index itself: 1/0 on the first tick, no value.

task.zh: 交出 1/2 + 1/4 + … 的部分和，和它与 1 的差距。
task.en: Give the partial sums of 1/2 + 1/4 + … and their gap from 1.

question.zh: 部分和离 1 还差多少？这个差距会变成 0 吗？
question.en: How far are the partial sums from 1? Does the gap ever reach 0?

chain.zh: 1/2, 1/4, … 是公比 1/2 的等比数列，累加起来。
chain.en: 1/2, 1/4, … is geometric with ratio 1/2; sum it.

chain.zh: 1 减去部分和：乘 −1 再加 1。差距每步减半，永远不是 0。
chain.en: 1 minus the partial sum: times −1, plus 1. The gap halves each step and is never 0.

facet.zh: 部分和与 1 的差距本身是无穷小：部分和逼近 1，却没有哪一项等于 1。
facet.en: The gap between the partial sums and 1 is itself infinitesimal: the sums close in on 1 though none equals it.

task.zh: 每一拍交出两个输入里大的那个。
task.en: Each tick give the larger of the two inputs.

question.zh: 板只会算，怎样在两个数里挑出大的？
question.en: The board only computes: how can it pick the larger of two numbers?

chain.zh: 比较给出 1 或 0：b 更大时是 1。
chain.en: Comparing gives 1 or 0: 1 when b is larger.

chain.zh: a 加上 (b − a) 乘这个 1 或 0：是 1 就变成 b，是 0 就还是 a。
chain.en: a plus (b − a) times that 1 or 0: with 1 it becomes b, with 0 it stays a.

task.zh: 每一拍交出两个输入隔多远：|a − b|。
task.en: Each tick give how far apart the two inputs are: |a − b|.

question.zh: a − b 时正时负，怎样只要隔多远？
question.en: a − b is sometimes negative: how do you get just how far apart?

chain.zh: a − b 和 b − a 一正一负（或都是 0）。
chain.en: a − b and b − a are one positive and one negative (or both 0).

chain.zh: 取两者里大的那个。
chain.en: Take the larger of the two.

naive.zh: 只算 a − b：b 更大时成了负数。
naive.en: Just a − b: negative when b is larger.

task.zh: aₙ 离 L 不到 ε 时交出 1，否则交出 0。
task.en: Give 1 when aₙ is less than ε from L, else 0.

question.zh: 怎样把「够近」变成一个能检查的 0 或 1？
question.en: How does “close enough” become a 0 or 1 that can be checked?

chain.zh: 先量 aₙ 和 L 隔多远。
chain.en: First measure how far aₙ is from L.

chain.zh: 再和 ε 比较：小于 ε 就是够近。
chain.en: Then compare with ε: less than ε is close enough.

task.zh: 输入每拍是 0 或 1：交出最近一段连续为 1 从第几项起；这一拍是 0 时交出 n + 1。
task.en: The input is 0 or 1 each tick: give where the latest unbroken run of 1s began; give n + 1 when this tick is 0.

question.zh: 一串 0 和 1，最近这段 1 从哪一项开始？
question.en: In a run of 0s and 1s, where did the latest stretch of 1s begin?

chain.zh: 这一拍是 1：开头和上一拍说的一样，由寄存卡记着。
chain.en: This tick is 1: the start is what the tick before said, held in a register.

chain.zh: 这一拍是 0：开头最早也得是下一项，n + 1。
chain.en: This tick is 0: the start can be no earlier than the next term, n + 1.

chain.zh: 用输入当 1 和 0 在两者里挑：f·旧值 + (1 − f)·(n + 1)。
chain.en: Use the input as 1 and 0 to pick between them: f·old + (1 − f)·(n + 1).

task.zh: aₙ 趋于 L：测试给出 ε，每一拍交出到这一拍为止的 N。
task.en: aₙ tends to L: the test gives ε; each tick give N as found so far.

question.zh: 加到哪一项都不等于 L，凭什么说它趋于 L？
question.en: No term equals L: on what grounds does the sequence tend to L?

chain.zh: 先说好多近才算近：ε。
chain.en: First agree how close counts: ε.

chain.zh: 每一拍检查 aₙ 在不在邻域里，看这段「在」从哪一项起。
chain.en: Each tick check whether aₙ is in the neighbourhood, and where the current stretch of “in” began.

chain.zh: N 停住了，就是这一拍以内找到了 N；ε 越小，N 越往后。
chain.en: When N stops moving, an N has been found within these ticks; the smaller ε, the later N.

naive.zh: 只看这一拍在不在邻域里：前面掉出去过也不管。
naive.en: Looking only at whether this tick is in the neighbourhood, ignoring any earlier escape.

question.zh: 极限不是 0 时，ε-N 照样适用吗？
question.en: Does ε-N work the same when the limit is not 0?

chain.zh: 数列要自己算：分子乘分母的倒数。
chain.en: Compute the sequence yourself: the numerator times the reciprocal of the denominator.

chain.zh: 邻域以 3 为中心，其余照旧。
chain.en: The neighbourhood is centred on 3; the rest is as before.

facet.zh: 被检查的数列由板自己算出，极限不是 0。
facet.en: The sequence checked is made on the board, and its limit is not 0.

task.en: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1), L = 0: give N.

question.zh: 一会儿在左、一会儿在右，还算趋于 0 吗？
question.en: Now left, now right: does it still tend to 0?

chain.zh: (−1)ⁿ 是首项 1、公比 −1 的等比数列。
chain.en: (−1)ⁿ is geometric with first term 1 and ratio −1.

chain.zh: 距离不看方向：两边的项一样算近。
chain.en: Distance ignores direction: terms on either side are close alike.

facet.zh: 数列在 L 两侧来回摆动；邻域只看距离，摆动不妨碍收敛。
facet.en: The sequence swings from side to side of L; the neighbourhood only sees distance, so swinging does not stop convergence.

task.zh: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ：测试给出 L 和 ε，交出 N。
task.en: aₙ = (−1)ⁿ: the test gives L and ε; give N.

question.zh: 一个数列能不能哪儿也不趋于？
question.en: Can a sequence tend nowhere at all?

chain.zh: L 取 1：每隔一项就掉出邻域，N 一直被往后推。
chain.en: With L = 1: every other term falls out, and N keeps being pushed back.

chain.zh: L 取别的数也一样：没有哪个 L 让 N 停下。
chain.en: Any other L does the same: no L lets N stop.

naive.zh: 看到 N 偶尔停一拍，就当找到了。
naive.en: Taking N standing still for a tick as found.

task.zh: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … 趋于 2：测试给出 ε，交出 N。
task.en: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … tends to 2: the test gives ε; give N.

question.zh: 无穷多项相加，等号右边的 2 是什么意思？
question.en: Infinitely many terms added: what does the 2 on the right mean?

chain.zh: 无穷多项加不完；能算的只有部分和。
chain.en: Infinitely many terms never finish adding; only partial sums can be computed.

chain.zh: 问部分和这个数列趋于什么：对它找 N。
chain.en: Ask what the sequence of partial sums tends to: find N for it.

task.zh: 交出 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + … 的部分和；再对测试给出的界 K，交出部分和从第几项起一直大于 K。
task.en: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …; then, for a bound K the test gives, give where the partial sums start staying above K.

question.zh: 每一项都趋于 0，和还会无限变大吗？
question.en: Every term tends to 0: can the sum still grow without bound?

chain.zh: 部分和长得很慢，看起来像停了。
chain.en: The partial sums grow so slowly they look stuck.

chain.zh: 给它一个界 K，比较「K 小于部分和」，从此一直：K 再大也找得到那一项。
chain.en: Give it a bound K, compare “K less than the sum”, and take ever since: however large K, that term is found.

naive.zh: 项趋于 0，就当和趋于某个数：对它找 N。
naive.en: Taking terms tending to 0 to mean the sum tends to something, and looking for its N.

question.zh: 1/n! 不必先算出 n! 再取倒数吗？
question.en: Must 1/n! wait for n! to be computed first?

chain.zh: n! = n·(n − 1)!：相邻两项只差一个因子。
chain.en: n! = n·(n − 1)!: neighbouring terms differ by one factor.

chain.zh: 于是 1/n! = 1/(n − 1)! · 1/n：递推，每步乘一个倒数。
chain.en: So 1/n! = 1/(n − 1)! · 1/n: a recurrence, multiplying by one reciprocal each step.

task.zh: 交出 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … 的部分和，和它离 e 不到 ε 的 N。
task.en: Give the partial sums of 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … and the N at which they come within ε of e.

question.zh: 一个由无穷多项定义的数，几项才算得准？
question.en: A number defined by infinitely many terms: how many terms make it accurate?

chain.zh: 把阶乘倒数接进累加。
chain.en: Feed the reciprocal factorials into the sum.

chain.zh: 对 e 找 N：阶乘长得飞快，N 很小。
chain.en: Find N for e: factorials grow so fast that N is small.

task.zh: 从 x₀ = 1 起，交出 xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + 2/xₙ)/2。
task.en: From x₀ = 1, give xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + 2/xₙ)/2.

question.zh: 只会加、乘和取倒数，怎样逼近 √2？
question.en: With only add, multiply and reciprocal, how do you close in on √2?

chain.zh: 猜 x 大了，2/x 就小了；√2 夹在两者之间。
chain.en: If a guess x is too large, 2/x is too small; √2 lies between them.

chain.zh: 取两者的平均当下一次的猜测，存回寄存卡。
chain.en: Take their average as the next guess and keep it.

task.zh: 交出 |xₙ² − 2| 和它小于 ε 的 N。
task.en: Give |xₙ² − 2| and the N at which it drops below ε.

question.zh: 巴比伦的猜测逼近得有多快？
question.en: How fast do the Babylonian guesses close in?

chain.zh: 误差用距离量：xₙ² 离 2 多远。
chain.en: Measure the error with distance: how far xₙ² is from 2.

chain.zh: 和 1/(n+1) 比：ε 缩小十倍，N 几乎不动。
chain.en: Compare with 1/(n+1): ε ten times smaller hardly moves N.

task.zh: 测试给出正数 c：从 1 起，交出逼近 √c 的猜测。
task.en: The test gives a positive c: from 1, give guesses closing in on √c.

question.zh: 换成别的数，同一台机器还能开方吗？
question.en: With another number, does the same machine still take the root?

chain.zh: 把 2 换成输入 c：c 乘 xₙ 的倒数。
chain.en: Replace 2 by the input c: c times the reciprocal of xₙ.

chain.zh: c 小于 1 时，第一次猜测大了，照样收回来。
chain.en: When c is below 1 the first guess is too large, and it still comes back.

why.zh: 求和与差分都只建在寄存卡、递推和下标上，彼此不需要；先做哪一路都行，汇合在互逆。
why.en: Summing and differencing each stand only on the register, recurrences and the index, not on each other; either may come first, and they meet at undoing.

why.zh: 倒数、比较和「从此一直」各建在第 0 章的元件上，彼此不需要；在极限汇合。
why.en: Reciprocal, comparison and “ever since” each stand on chapter 0’s parts, not on each other; they meet at the limit.

about.zh: 值是数，不是位；板上没有线和「说」：只有输入数列和输出。原始元件：加、乘、常数、寄存卡一对。测试写出每个输入每拍的项和每个输出每拍应当的项（物化成数据，不由公式生成）。
about.en: Values are numbers, not bits; boards have no line and no say card, only input sequences and outputs. Primitives: add, multiply, constant, the register pair. A test lists each input’s terms and each output’s wanted terms, tick by tick (materialised data, not generated by formula).

note.zh: kit/domains/calculus：输入、输出数列两种固定卡，加、乘、常数、寄存卡一对；测试写明每拍的项；常数和初值是任意数（registerCards 的 numbers）。
note.en: kit/domains/calculus: input and output sequence cards, add, multiply, constant and the register pair; tests list every term; constants and start values take any number (registerCards numbers).

about.zh: 一种画逐拍数值的显示方式：每一项一个点，横轴是下标、纵轴是值（数列图），和应当的项叠在一起，能一眼看出增长的快慢。
about.en: A view of tick-by-tick numbers: a dot per term, the index across and the value up (a sequence plot), drawn over the wanted terms so growth is seen at a glance.

note.zh: 逐拍的数值多了两种显示方式：逐项（每拍一列写出数）和数列图（每项一个点，应当的项画成圈，同一刻度）；游戏的 views 选用它们。
note.en: Values a tick gain two views: terms (each tick’s number in its column) and plot (a dot a term, the wanted terms as rings on one scale); the game’s views pick them.

about.zh: 原始元件加上倒数（1/0 给「—」）和比较（a < b 给 1，否则 0）；测试的项按相对误差 10⁻⁹ 对照，运算顺序造成的末位差别不算错。
about.en: Primitives gain reciprocal (「—」 for 1/0) and less (1 when a < b, else 0); a test’s terms are compared within a relative error of 10⁻⁹, so differences in the last bits from the order of operations are no error.

note.zh: kit/domains/calculus：原始元件 recip、less；run.js 的 same 按相对误差 10⁻⁹ 对照。
note.en: kit/domains/calculus: primitives recip and less; run.js same compares within a relative error of 10⁻⁹.

about.zh: 第 2–7 章：取样、导数、积分、基本定理、泰勒、微分方程
about.en: Chapters 2–7: sampling, derivative, integral, the fundamental theorem, Taylor, differential equations

why.zh: 同上；框架在设计文档第 3 节
why.en: As above; the framework is in the design document, §3
